# n8n-manager-mcp - MCP Server for n8n Workflow Management

> n8n-manager-mcp is an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that lets AI assistants like Claude, Cursor, and Windsurf manage n8n workflows end-to-end: list, create, update, delete, activate, export, import, and inspect executions. Connects directly to the n8n REST API with no Python dependency, and supports multiple n8n instances at once.

19 tools covering complete n8n workflow management: n8n_list_workflows, n8n_get_workflow (full node graph + connections), n8n_create_workflow (from nodes + connections), n8n_update_workflow, n8n_delete_workflow, n8n_activate_workflow (toggle on/off), n8n_list_executions (recent runs with status), n8n_export_workflow (importable JSON), n8n_import_workflow, n8n_safety_status, n8n_set_safety_mode, n8n_list_backups, n8n_restore_workflow, n8n_describe_nodes (category-filtered text descriptions of common node types, not full schemas), n8n_add_server, n8n_list_servers, n8n_remove_server, n8n_ping_server, n8n_manager_history (opt-in, read-only: version history, recorded decisions, and sync history from a running n8n-workflow-manager module; enabled with N8N_MCP_MANAGER_URL, never falls back to a direct n8n query when the manager is unreachable). Multi-server support routes to configured n8n instances. When backup_before_mutations is enabled (default: true), snapshots are made before update, delete, activate/deactivate, and restore-overwrite operations. n8n_import_workflow creates a new workflow without a pre-import backup or rollback handle. Restore from a local backup is available; local audit logging is configurable and enabled by default.

Verification (2026-11-02): fresh `npm test`, build, smoke discovery, and
package dry-run pass with 208 Vitest tests (100% pass).
The 2026-11-02 audit of the unreleased source lockfile reports zero known advisories.
It locks @hono/node-server 2.1.6 and qs 6.17.1, above the patched floors for
GHSA-rmxm-3fg6-px4f and GHSA-6pq8-jhm2-2vcw; every other locked package version is preserved.
The package dry-run contains the built server and smoke discovery reports all
19 tools.

Part of the ellmos family. Node.js, MIT. Published as `n8n-manager-mcp` on npm. Publicly listed on Glama, Enterprise DNA, and PulseMCP under the ellmos-ai namespace. Some MCP ecosystem indexes still expose the legacy `io.github.lukisch/n8n-manager-mcp` entry; this repository includes `server.json` for the ellmos-ai namespace.

## Audience

- AI assistant users who work with n8n and want to manage workflows via Claude, Cursor, or Windsurf
- Developers building AI agents that automate workflow orchestration via n8n
- DevOps and automation engineers integrating n8n into AI-assisted pipelines
- Power users managing multiple n8n instances and needing AI-driven workflow operations
- Open-source contributors exploring MCP server development with TypeScript and Node.js

Current safety contract: backup path segments are sanitized and resolved
under the configured backup root; reserved names, traversal, and symlink or
reparse escapes are rejected or mapped safely, and listing returns only
regular JSON backup files. `n8n_add_server` preserves an existing default when
`is_default` is omitted on update; `true` promotes and explicit `false`
removes the flag, with first-server fallback when no default remains.
